correctness.rationale: For a first chosen vertex in part P, all outside P and that vertex are dominated. Subsequent P vertices footprint themselves; first outside-P choice, if legal, footprints all remaining P and ends sequence. Thus maximum m and exactly the two families; permutations give A=t m!(N-m+1) for m>=2, and B=t[1+m(N-m)] for m>=3, with separate m=2 singleton correction and complete-graph m=1. Independently enumerated ALL legal sequences for 63 profiles with 2-4 parts, part sizes 1-3, total <=7, reproducing both counts; general proof does not extrapolate from checks.
